newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures cut losses late, end lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures cut losses late, end lower.

text.p: Jan 3 - IMM currency futures cut losses in light late trade, most still ended lower. Brokers said March Swiss francs edged back up after small fund selling from $0.7400 to new contract low at $0.7386 ended. March yen, marks also set new contract lows Friday. Rallies in U.S. bond, stock markets added weight. Some wait for players overseas to return in full force Monday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
